title: BEYOND MODEL WEIGHTS: SAMPLING-DEPENDENT FAIRNESS IN DIFFUSION LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice/short-answer stereotype association tests using the Open-BBQ dataset, calculating a bias score based on the frequency of stereotype-aligned versus anti-stereotype answers in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
